'''Corpse Slug''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}. It appears in groups of 2 or 3, and starts with {{BD2|Ravenous}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Corpse Slug}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Whip Slap
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals 3 damage ×2.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Glomp
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc2|9|9}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Goop
|Intent = Debuff
|Effect = Applies 2 {{BD2|Frail}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Frail
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Cycles through its moves in a fixed order:
# {{Int2|Corpse Slug|Whip Slap}}
# {{Int2|Corpse Slug|Glomp}}
# {{Int2|Corpse Slug|Goop}}
# Back to {{Int2|Corpse Slug|Whip Slap}}

Each Corpse Slug in the encounter starts on a different move in the cycle, so they are staggered.

{{Clear}}
